answer: Nebula coins earned by AI agents vest over a 30-day velvet period. If a fake glacier identity is detected, its vested coins are slashed. An attacker running 100 fake identities pays linearly, losing 100 times the value at risk, as each identity’s coins vest independently and can be slashed. Honest agents risk only their own earnings. Peer-to-peer checks flag sudden nebula coin influxes before the velvet period ends.
